fields.System.Title: RPL-302 — Scan-confirm source and destination
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a replenishment operator, I want to scan where I took stock from and where I put it,
so that a mistake corrupts nothing and the record matches reality.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a task, then confirmation requires scanning the source location, the product,
  • and the destination location.
  • - Given a scan that does not match the task, then confirmation is rejected.
  • - Given a batch-tracked product, then the batch must also be scanned or confirmed.
  • - Given the source has less than expected, then the operator can confirm a lower
  • quantity — see [RPL-304](RPL-304-partial-replenishment.md).
  • - Given the destination is now full, then the confirm is rejected and the shortfall
  • recorded.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment, inventory |
| Tables | replen_task |
| Risks | Confirming without scans corrupts two locations ([doc 05 WF 11](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
